design_evidence: Early-only development diagnosis used the original #73 training roster, existing opponent-adjusted goal-only rates and authentic earlier labels; ignore all shot features and fitted #73 parameters. Of 2070 qualifying fixtures, true score rank<=1/3/5/10/20 counts 265/633/975/1533/1973. Mode WDL wrong in 1165, mode WDL correct but score wrong in 640. One-goal wins ending 2-1/1-2 observed 336 vs sum of unconditional baseline probabilities 294.63, 3-2/2-3 were 90 vs 94.24, 1-1 was 243 vs 215.08. Raw margins/win/draw do not by themselves identify conditional effects; report training residual given the actual signed margin separately. Design used this training set and the candidate is exploratory.
baseline: Unchanged prior_team_strength.LeagueStrength prior_goals; independent score_form.poisson_matrix, 31x31. Same domestic competition and season, 120-day half-life, native coefficient ridges, venue prior and caps. Same source teams, >=60 prior regular league fixtures, both identified in season. No shots, recent drought, half-time, dismissal, rest, transition clock or current market price enters either forecast.
one_change: For EVERY signed goal difference d=h-a in an individual baseline matrix, keep the sum of its diagonal exactly, including draws. Within d multiply the odds of the single cell with min(h,a)=1, if present, versus all other cells on that same diagonal by exp(beta). Enumerate every possible d at prediction; the actual result is unknown. Preserve all existing zero cells, original conditional odds among the other cells, and every handicap/WDL marginal (all signed margins). Team scoring/blank, both-teams-score and totals including O/U may change. This differs from the four DC cells, draw inflation, BTTS binary or total-preserving home allocation.
fit: One common beta across all six leagues and signed margins, including home/away and tied fixtures. Use the joint-score likelihood with fixed diagonal masses, equivalently logistic loss on min(actual)=1 conditioning on the observed training margin d with offset from that fixture's own matrix. Fit beta once in [-log(3),log(3)] with 0.5*5*beta^2 penalty. No league-specific fit, alternative target, refit, grid, home/away split or model selection on late outcomes; beta=0 exactly reproduces baseline.
training_window: Use only original training rows of the three seasons starting 2019, 2020 and 2021, full November, January, March and May blocks as in pinned reader. Strength inputs at each first-of-month use only dates through the calendar day two days before month start; strip shot information. 2206 roster, 2070 pairs. Protocol precedes any grading of the chosen later January rows in this study.
historical_window: All January league fixtures in 2023, 2024, 2025 from the same six leagues. Source date/Div-only discovery counted 612 identities before grading. Fixed January 1 origin in each season; use only same-season regular-time matches with source date before December 31 (through December 30). No future-season ratings, target scores, target match statistics or current prices in inputs; no rolling use of earlier January outcomes. Both arms preserve the original later roster and eligibility. Archive lacks contemporaneous fixture schedule and field-ingest clocks so date-separated historical development only. #68 reviewed whole seasons; no claim of project-wide unseen data. January differs from #69's late November–December, #70's February–April, #72's August–November historical and #73's May.
grading: Seal both forecasts, exact matrix hashes, choices and gaps for the complete January roster before reading target results. Score matrix modal first, ranked 3/5/10/20, WDL and actual Asian total full-win; original code for WDL/score selection and five-way settle_ou. For historical totals precompute the 2.5 direction for every forecast, then count only rows with both sides of the named Bet365 2.5 line. Original quote times unknown. No actual delivered top1/three or pre-ranked 3/3 absent paired original deliveries.
optional_archival_coverage: Locate an entire immutable pre-November-2026 roster with genuine first-issued normalized matrices and regular-time evidence that is identity-disjoint from R7 and the previous 61/#69–73 panels. decision: For referral to a separate genuine future evaluation: >=500 pooled historical paired forecasts, all three independent calendar years present, positive lower 95% paired date-block bound on Top1 gain, positive first-score net in at least two of three years, nonnegative pooled matrix Top3/WDL/strict real-line OU and non-worsening whole-score log loss. Otherwise stop this recipe. No promotion, deployment, R7 alteration, new future issue or standing experimental queue.
